claims.statement: Copy-project guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES and uses existing project as configuration template; it does not specify exhaustive role or cross-owner permission requirements.

Copied configuration includes views, custom fields, configured workflows except auto-add, and insights. Configuration duplication is not proof enabled/effective automation, equivalent access or execution history.

Reusable lists draft issues and field values among copied content, while overview says original items not copied and procedure makes draft copying optional. Preserve optional-draft exception rather than claiming no items whatsoever or unconditional draft transfer.
Collaborators, team links and repository links are explicitly not copied. No copied project may be assumed to inherit verified reader/writer access or repository relationships.

Configured workflows other than auto-add can carry behavior affecting issue/status/archive state; assess effective enabled state and destination applicability before any authorized copy. Source does not prove exact enabled-state preservation.

Copy flow selects optional draft copying, destination organization/personal owner and new name. Choosing owner/copying can move draft content into another access context; no project copied or private content transferred.

Organization templates and recommended-template curation are separate linked capabilities, not automatically established by copying. All claims reference-only; no accepted policy, rights clearance, native rollout or new project behavior receipt.
